messages.text: Hi, when is the earliest the Thor p2 will ship to a Canadian address?
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2

For a Canadian address the Thor P2 page shows Ships October 29, 2026, from our Canadian warehouse. That's the earliest I can promise you, and I won't quote earlier than the page does.

It's $379 right now, down from $449, 10 TH/s at about 166 W and around 40 dB, so it's fine in a home office.

Want me to put one in a cart for you, or are you still weighing it against the BS-4 or the NerdOctaxe?
